subject: PartnerPulse: Co-hosted Embedded Demo Series with ForgeBridge
messages:
From: Ari Patel <ari@forgebridge.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership idea — short embedded demo series?

Hi Soojin,

Quick intro — I'm Ari on Partnerships at ForgeBridge. We run a small ISV ecosystem and have several customers asking for tighter integrations around low-latency embeddings and inference routing. Would Redwood be open to co-hosting a short (30–40 minute) demo series called "Embedded Demo Sessions" — three episodes, each focusing on a vertical (search, customer support, and personalization)?

High-level ask: co-hosted webinar platform, 20–25 minute demo + 10–15 minute Q&A, blog swap and a joint follow-up playbook. We can cover speaker ops and marketing reach. Typical attendance target per episode: 200–400 engineers/product folks.

Attached is a short partner prospectus with audience data (see filename: forgebridge_partner_onepager.pdf).

If this sounds interesting, could we get 20 minutes next week to align on scope & tentative dates?

Best,
Ari Patel
Head of Partnerships, ForgeBridge
ari@forgebridge.com

--
Attachment: forgebridge_partner_onepager.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com
To: Ari Patel <ari@forgebridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership idea — short embedded demo series?

Thanks for the note Ari — love the concept. Redwood is definitely interested in a 3-part embedded demo series, and the attendance targets you listed are in range for a co-marketing push. A few quick clarifying items before we schedule:

- Audience: are these sessions aimed at platform/infra engineers or product/ML engineers? We usually tailor demos (and TOC) differently.
- Timeline: do you have a target month for episode 1? We have product windows in Oct/Nov for new inference features.
- Logistics: will ForgeBridge handle registration and CTAs, or do you want a joint landing page?

I've attached a lightweight internal draft agenda to help kickoff planning: draft_agenda.pdf (internal). Can you confirm whether ForgeBridge needs Redwood slides that highlight dedicated deployment options and cost/perf benchmarks? Ben (cc'd) will lead technical content, Marissa will own marketing ops.

If you're free, propose Mon 2026-09-14 10:00am PT for a 20-minute sync. Otherwise suggest a slot.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com
Phone: +1-415-555-0123

--
Attachment: draft_agenda.pdf (DOCX, 18KB)
From: Lena Morales <lena@forgebridge.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com, Ari Patel <ari@forgebridge.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership idea — short embedded demo series?

Hi Soojin / Ari — thanks for the quick reply. Couple of specifics from our side:

- Primary audience: product + ML engineers who own embedding/semantic search features. We can push to our customer list (mostly mid-market SaaS) and developer newsletter — expect 150–300 per episode with joint promotion.
- Target for episode 1: week of Nov 9 — gives marketing ~8 weeks to promote and time for slide reviews.
- Registration + landing page: ForgeBridge can host registration and supply a joint co-branded landing page; would like Redwood to add an optional "Request a Dedicated Trial" CTA.

We attached a ZIP with brand assets and a suggested slide skeleton (forgebridge_brand.zip). We also drafted a proposed co-branded slide deck, initial draft: sample_slides_v1.pptx.

Notes on content: we'd like a short integration demo that shows a combined workflow: ForgeBridge ingestion -> Redwood hosted embeddings -> similarity search in-app. Karthik (cc'd by Ari below) on the integrations team may want to highlight a plugin story — happy to hand off technical follow-up.

Tell us if Nov 9–13 window works. We can do the 20-min sync on Mon 9/14 10am PT; if that works we'll use that to lock speakers and action items.

Thanks,
Lena Morales
Sr. Partnerships Manager, ForgeBridge
lena@forgebridge.com

--
Attachments: forgebridge_brand.zip (ZIP, 2.1MB), sample_slides_v1.pptx (PPTX, 4.4MB)
From: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
To: Lena Morales <lena@forgebridge.com>, Ari Patel <ari@forgebridge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood-inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com, soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership idea — short embedded demo series?

Appreciate the materials, Lena — looks good. A few operational items from Redwood Marketing & Field: 

- Confirmed schedule: Episode 1 target week Nov 9. Please share 3 preferred dates/times for the live slot (we prefer Tue/Wed late morning PT).
- Promo assets: we'll need logos (svg/png), speaker headshots, 50/100/300-word abstracts for event page, and a 1-page joint playbook PDF to gate after the series.
- Landing page & registration: Redwood can run the joint landing page if you prefer — we have a template that supports co-registration and HubSpot tracking. If ForgeBridge hosts, we need an embed iframe for our CTA.
- Speakers: Proposed Redwood on-stage: Ben Carter (Field Eng) + Karthik Iyer (Integrations). Proposed ForgeBridge: Ari (partnerships) + their lead PM. Who's the lead PM?
- Legal/Procurement: For any marketing spend or lead sharing, legal asks a quick MSA addendum. Can you confirm whether ForgeBridge will insist on a vendor contract for joint promotion? If yes we'll loop Legal.

Action items and owners (propose):
- ForgeBridge: confirm lead PM, provide final logos + headshots (Lena) — due 2026-09-21
- Redwood: draft landing page + registration flow (Marissa) — due 2026-09-28
- Tech sync: Ben & Karthik to do a technical dry-run with ForgeBridge eng (schedule after 10/15)

Drive link with our event playbook and possible dates: https://redwood-inference.app/drive/partner-pulse-brief

If everyone is aligned, we'll treat this as a co-marketing experiment tied to deal FB-7890 and track signups as MQLs in HubSpot.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole

Thanks all — this is actionable and I think we have alignment. Quick recap and next steps (owners + due dates):

1) Confirm episode 1 slot (target week Nov 9) — ForgeBridge to send 3 preferred times (Lena) by 2026-09-21.
2) Creative & assets — ForgeBridge to share logos/headshots + final slide deck; Redwood (Marissa) to prepare landing page and co-branded sign-up by 2026-09-28.
3) Technical runbook — Ben & Karthik to schedule a 60-min integration dry-run with ForgeBridge eng between 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-30.
4) Legal: if ForgeBridge requires an MSA addendum for lead-sharing, please flag by 2026-09-21 so we can loop Legal.
5) Measurement: tie signups to HubSpot deal FB-7890 and track MQL conversion (Marissa).

Marissa / Ben / Karthik — please each respond in-thread with availability blockers for the technical run and any constraints on slide content (we try to keep benchmarks public but can mute exact per-customer numbers).

Looking forward — happy to be point person for Redwood on overall partnership ops.
